title: Biocon
summary: Indian biopharmaceutical group making biosimilars and generic APIs.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Biocon develops and manufactures biosimilars, generic active ingredients and specialty pharmaceuticals, with a focus on insulin, oncology and immunology. Its subsidiary Biocon Biologics sells biosimilars in developed markets. Regulatory approvals and price erosion drive results.

Technology Exposure

  • Biosimilar medicines
  • Generic APIs
  • Research services

What To Watch

  • US and EU biosimilar approvals
  • Price erosion
  • Manufacturing quality

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
